title: Synthetic shared-agent research session
instructions: Answer questions using only the material included in the published share.

messages.content: What should the first prototype demonstrate?
It should demonstrate explicit selection of completed turns and files, followed by an isolated recipient continuation.
Should the recipient receive the owner's long-term memory?
No. The recipient should receive only the published session projection and their own continuation transcript.
This turn is still being processed and must not be shareable.
